claim: The repo reports that the SoW save editor's fixed function RVAs do not fit Steam build 3095001 while byte-pattern signatures do, and that hooking tiny leaf stubs must preserve volatile registers or the game crashes.
evidence: NOTES session k: save editor RVAs 'all land mid-function'; session m: crash root cause was 'our hook, not the game' (clobbered r9).
game_build_compatibility: Repo-reported for Steam app 356190 build 3095001, ShadowOfWar.exe 1.0.8874.0, SHA-256 ed0d95cabb033cd66aaa99d699374881846c3cb03ec345f1123d82d45e0bdaef; not checked against our install.
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Reported by one party for one build; not reproduced. Also reports .arch code section identical on disk and in memory, permitting static analysis, which we have not checked.
next_experiment: Adopt the rule 'signatures that match exactly once, never borrowed RVAs'; in a later phase, verify statically (read-only) whether .arch on our exe matches the reported layout.
